# Notes on Accessible Navigation

2025-11-02

---

This is a placeholder post about navigation. It is not a report of real user research.

A navigation list should use real links, keep a logical focus order, and show a visible focus indicator. Decorative icons never replace visible text labels.

The site will add the sidebar and drawer in a later task. Keeping the content model and routes stable first makes that work easier to test.
